input._script:
using CUDA
using JSON3

sh(c) = try replace(strip(read(`bash -c $c`, String)), "\n" => " | ") catch e; "ERR" end
r = Dict{String,Any}()

r["active_project"]   = string(Base.active_project())
r["depot"]            = string(DEPOT_PATH)
r["driver"]           = string(CUDA.driver_version())
r["runtime"]          = string(CUDA.runtime_version())
try r["cuda_jl_version"] = string(pkgversion(CUDA)) catch e; r["cuda_jl_version"]="ERR" end

# does the setter exist, and where does it live?
for (nm, mod) in (("CUDA", CUDA),)
    r["$(nm)_has_set_runtime_version"] = isdefined(mod, :set_runtime_version!)
    r["$(nm)_has_reset_runtime_version"] = isdefined(mod, :reset_runtime_version!)
end
try
    r["set_runtime_version_methods"] = replace(string(methods(CUDA.set_runtime_version!)), "\n" => " | ")
catch e
    r["set_runtime_version_methods"] = "ERR: " * sprint(showerror, e)
end

# where would the preference be written, and what is there now?
proj = dirname(something(Base.active_project(), ""))
lp = joinpath(proj, "LocalPreferences.toml")
r["localprefs_path"]   = lp
r["localprefs_exists"] = isfile(lp)
r["localprefs_body"]   = isfile(lp) ? replace(read(lp, String), "\n" => " | ") : "<none>"
r["proj_writable"]     = try (touch(joinpath(proj, ".wtest")); rm(joinpath(proj, ".wtest")); true) catch e; false end

# is a local (system) CUDA toolkit available as an alternative?
r["nvcc_on_path"] = sh("command -v nvcc || echo none")
r["hpcsdk_cuda"]  = sh("ls -d /softs/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/24.1/cuda/bin/nvcc 2>&1")
r["hpcsdk_nvcc_v"]= sh("/softs/nvidia/hpc_sdk/Linux_x86_64/24.1/cuda/bin/nvcc --version 2>&1 | tail -2")

io = IOBuffer(); CUDA.versioninfo(io)
r["versioninfo"] = replace(String(take!(io)), "\n" => " | ")

println(JSON3.write(Dict("probe" => r)))
